description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the named subarea. Regional Transit Authority boundary polygons are compiled from legal descriptions and aligned to tax parcels. These source-defined assets, service areas or operating constraints provide inputs for capacity planning studies. The authority area is a jurisdictional constraint for transit planning, not route geometry or evidence of service at every location. Access is through the public county catalogue and ArcGIS REST layer metadata, with GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile export descriptors advertised by the provider. No feature records or files were downloaded. Licence terms are referred to a county PDF that was not opened; charges are not stated. The additional county GIS metadata HTML route failed during TLS negotiation. A limitation is that field definitions do not establish attribute completeness, present serviceability or observation dates. A regular update frequency is not stated. No exact related active resource was established for this group.
